context: Check the proposed tool calls in the bundled batch 'batch-1.json' against the tool schemas. The bundled data is written out in full below; parse each call's arguments and each schema as JSON and apply these rules exactly. A schema is a flat object with "type": "object", "properties" and "required". Each property has a "type": string, integer, number, boolean or array; an array has "items" with a scalar type; a string or integer property may have an "enum". Rules: (1) A required parameter the arguments do not give is MISSING_REQUIRED. (2) Types are strict JSON types with no coercion: integer is only a JSON integer token (7 is one; 7.0, 7e0 and "7" are not), number is any JSON number, a boolean is never an integer or number, and null is the wrong type for every parameter (a required parameter given as null is WRONG_TYPE, not missing). (3) An array must be a JSON array whose every item has the items type; any number of bad items is one WRONG_TYPE for that parameter; an empty array is valid. (4) The enum check applies only when the type is right: a wrong-type value is WRONG_TYPE only, never also NOT_IN_ENUM; enum matching is exact and case-sensitive. (5) An argument the schema's properties do not name is UNKNOWN_PARAMETER; names are case-sensitive. (6) A call is valid exactly when it has no violation; a call with no arguments to a tool with nothing required is valid. Schemas: book_room = {"type":"object","properties":{"room":{"type":"string","enum":["small","large"]},"guests":{"type":"integer"},"date":{"type":"string"},"projector":{"type":"boolean"}},"required":["room","guests","date"]}; log_reading = {"type":"object","properties":{"sensor":{"type":"string"},"value":{"type":"number"},"tags":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}},"unit":{"type":"string","enum":["c","f"]}},"required":["sensor","value"]}; list_notes = {"type":"object","properties":{"limit":{"type":"integer"},"folder":{"type":"string"}},"required":[]}; set_levels = {"type":"object","properties":{"levels":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"integer"}},"channel":{"type":"integer","enum":[1,2,3]}},"required":["levels"]}.
